value.rationale: For extrapolation to an entire ball, fixed radial covariance leaves many genuinely different sampling designs and projector norms. The result solves the complete infinite-dimensional worst-design optimization, proves uniqueness of all optimal radial laws and identifies two sharp, non-obvious disk phase transitions. Its one-versus-two-shell structure and the moment-dependent thresholds are mathematically motivated and not a prescribed small numerical slice.
